relationships.subject: GABAA receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: were blocked by nimodipine (RM-ANOVA F(2,10) = 33.5, p < 0.001, n = 6) indicating a primary role for dihydropyridine sensitive L-type calcium channels

relationships.subject: Bumetanide
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, GABA-evoked calcium responses in DRG neurons exhibited a strong dependence on chloride gradients, since blockade of the NKCC1 transporter with 25μM bumetanide substantially decreased the calcium signals evoked by GABA 200μM.

relationships.subject: GABA
relationships.evidence_quote: GABA-evoked calcium responses in DRG neurons exhibited a GABAAR pharmacology

key_findings: GABA evokes GABAAR- and NKCC1-dependent calcium transients in about 20% of mouse DRG neurons
Intradermal GABA and furosemide (NKCC1 block) did not induce or modify pain or itch in healthy human volunteers
